live.title: Bukela ukwakhiwa kwakho live
live.subtitle: Bona isayithi yakho 24/7 — useLondon, eJohannesburg loba eTexas.

land.title: Ukuhlolwa kweSitandi & Due Diligence
land.description: Ungakabhadali isitandi, siqinisekisa ukuthi singesiqotho, sibekwe izikhonkwane kuhle njalo sihlanzekile emthethweni. Ummeli oleziqu uhlola i-title (kugoqelwe emsebenzini). Isikhulu sekhansili siqinisekisa izikhonkwane endaweni. Iqembu lethu lilinganisa isitandi, libhale i-GPS, lithathe izithombe lamavidiyo alosuku. Uthola umbiko obhaliweyo olezixwayiso zonke zichasiswa ngamazwi alula.

materials.title: Ukuthenga Impahla Yokwakha
materials.description: Sitshele okudingwa yikwakha kwakho, sibuthe amakhotheshini kubathengisi, eqathaniswe. Akulalutho oluthengwayo uze uvume ngombhalo. Irisidi yinye ngayinye ithathwa isithombe yabiwe lawe, lokulethwa kwempahla kubhalwa ngezithombe.

monitoring.title: Ukuvakatshelwa kweSayithi & Ukugadwa koKwakha
monitoring.description: Ukuvakatshelwa kwesayithi yakho njalonjalo ngezithombe ezilosuku, izilinganiso lemibiko elula yenqubekela phambili — ukuze uhlale usazi okwenzakalayo sibili.

camera.title: Ikhamera yeSayithi Live (24/7)
camera.bullet1: Bukela ukwakhiwa kwakho live loba ungaphi
camera.bullet2: Isebenza ngelanga, isebenza lanxa kucitshwe amagetsi
camera.description: Ikhamera esebenza ngelanga esayithini yakho, ebonisa live njalo irekhode kucloud — ukuze ubukele ukwakhiwa kwakho loba ungaphi, lempahla yakho ivikelwe lapho abakhi besesayithini.

servicesPage.title: Imisebenzi yethu
servicesPage.intro: I-LBH yinkampani yemisebenzi — iqembu lethu eZimbabwe lenza umsebenzi wakho. Umsebenzi munye ngamunye uqala ngocingo lwamahala, kulandele ikhotheshini ebhaliweyo. Akulantengo eboniswa obala; ikhotheshini yakho ngeyakho wedwa.
servicesPage.notifyHint: Lo umsebenzi uyeza. Tshono "Ngazisa" ocingweni lwakho lwamahala, sizakwazisa usuqalile.

howPage.title: Kusebenza njani
howPage.intro: Uhambo olulodwa olucacileyo, kusukela ocingweni lwakuqala kusiya embikweni ophelileyo. Uvuma isinyathelo sinye ngasinye — akulalutho oluhambayo ungekho.
howPage.note: Ubhadala uhambo lunye ngalunye esiluhambayo sikumele. Nxa siphambanisa, silungisa ngemali yethu. Akulahambo lokwengeza loba intengo yokwengeza eyenzakalayo ungavumanga kuportal.
howPage.stage1Text: Imizuzu engu-30–45, ucingo loba ividiyo. Usitshela ngesitandi sakho loba ukwakha kwakho. Akubhadalwa.
howPage.stage2Text: Ngemva kocingo uthola ikhotheshini ebhaliweyo — imbadalo yomsebenzi lemali yohambo elinganisiweyo, ngezinombolo ezicacileyo. YiLBH kuphela ebeka intengo; intengo kaziboniswa kuwebhusayithi le.
howPage.stage3Text: Vuma ikhotheshini kuportal yakho — ibizo lakho lesikhathi kubhalwa njengokuvuma okubhaliweyo. Ubhadala idiphozithi engu-50% ngekhadi, i-EcoCash lezinye izindlela, loba usitshele ukuthi ubhadale ngebhanga loba nge-remittance.
howPage.stage4Text: Iqembu lethu lenza umsebenzi — ngezithombe lamavidiyo alosuku le-GPS. Abasebenzi basensimini kabaziboni intengo njalo kabasayini umsebenzi wabo ngokwabo.
howPage.stage5Text: Umbiko munye ngamunye wasensimini uqala uye ku-admin yeLBH. I-admin iyawuhlola iwukhiphe kuwe — kakho osayina umsebenzi wakhe ngokwakhe.
howPage.stage6Text: Isinqumo esicacileyo phezulu, okutholakeleyo ngamazwi alula, izilinganiso, izithombe ezilosuku lerisidi yinye ngayinye. Nxa uhambo lubize okuncane kulokulinganisiweyo, uyabuyiselwa imali.
howPage.stage7Text: Nxa umbiko usukhitshiwe, ubhadala u-50% oseleyo. Kuphelile — njalo silungele isinyathelo sakho esilandelayo.

aboutPage.title: Nge-LBH
aboutPage.intro: I-LBH — Let's Build Home — isiza abantu beZimbabwe abahlala emzini ukuhlola isitandi, ukuthenga impahla yokwakha lokulandela ukwakha kwabo ekhaya, bengekho khona.
aboutPage.whoText: Siyinkampani yemisebenzi eseZimbabwe. Kasisiso isimakethe njalo kasithengisi umhlabathi — iqembu lethu lenza umsebenzi wakho: ummeli oleziqu wokuhlola i-title, i-architect/project manager, labameli basensimini abathembekileyo.
aboutPage.whyText: Abantu abanengi kakhulu abasemzini balahlekelwa yimali ngezitandi zamanga, impahla enyamalalayo lokwakha okungahambiyo. I-LBH ikhona ukuze imali yakho ingahambi ungavumanga — njalo ubone, ngezithombe lemibiko, okwenzakalayo sibili emhlabathini wakho.
aboutPage.value2: Kakho osayina umsebenzi wakhe ngokwakhe — umbiko munye ngamunye uyahlolwa ungakawuboni.
aboutPage.value3: Irisidi yinye ngayinye ithathwa isithombe yabiwe.
aboutPage.teamText: Ummeli oleziqu (i-title lokuhlola komthetho), i-architect / project manager, labameli basensimini kulo lonke eleZimbabwe. Imininingwane egcweleyo yeqembu iyeza.

termsPage.title: Imithetho yoMsebenzi
termsPage.intro: Le mithetho ibusa imisebenzi eyenziwa yiLBH (Let's Build Home). Izichasiso ezilula ziqala esigabeni sinye ngasinye; ziyingxenye yemithetho.
termsPage.s1Text: I-LBH yinkampani yemisebenzi eseZimbabwe, eqhutshwa yi-[LBH ZIMBABWE ENTITY NAME · REG NUMBER]. Sisebenza ngemilayo yakho ebhaliweyo: ukuhlola isitandi, ukuthenga impahla yokwakha lokugada ukwakha sikumele. Kasisiso isimakethe, i-estate agent, loba umthengisi womhlabathi loba impahla.
termsPage.s2Text: Umsebenzi munye ngamunye uqala ngocingo lwamahala, besesikuthumela ikhotheshini ebhaliweyo. Umsebenzi uqala kuphela ngemva kokuvuma ikhotheshini lokubhadala idiphozithi engu-50%. Eseleyo ibhadalwa nxa umbiko wakho usukhitshiwe. Imali yonke ingama-US dollars.
termsPage.s3Text: Ubhadala uhambo lunye ngalunye esiluhambayo sikumele, njengoba kubhaliwe ekhotheshinini yakho. Uhambo luqathaniswa lamarisidi: nxa uhambo lubize okuncane kulokulinganisiweyo, umahluko uyabuyiselwa kuwe.
termsPage.s4Text: Akulahambo lokwengeza, inhlawulo, imbadalo yekhansili loba enye intengo yokwengeza eyenziwayo ungakavumi kuportal. Umsebenzi uyama uze uvume loba wale.
termsPage.s5Text: Nxa i-LBH iphambanisa, i-LBH ilungisa ngemali yayo. Lokhu kakugoqeli inkinga ezibangelwa ngabanye, iziphathamandla, loba ulwazi owasinika lona olungaqondanga.
termsPage.s6Text: Umbiko wokuhlola isitandi luhlolo lwenyama lolwamaphepha olwenziwa ngosuku oluthile. Kayisiso isiqinisekiso se-title, inani loba izehlakalo zakusasa, njalo kayisiso iseluleko somthetho ngaphandle kokutholwe ngummeli okubhaliweyo kuwo.
termsPage.s7Text: I-LBH isebenza ngemilayo yeklayenti. Nguwe olomlandu wokuqinisekisa ukuthi imilayo lamaphepha owasinika wona aqondile.
termsPage.s8Text: Imibuzo ngale mithetho: sithinte nge-email loba iWhatsApp ekhasini lokuSithinta.

privacyPage.title: Umthetho weBumfihlo
privacyPage.intro: I-LBH ihlonipha ubumfihlo bakho. Lo umthetho uchasisa esikubuthayo, kungani, lamalungelo akho. Ubhalwe ukuthi uhambelane leCyber and Data Protection Act yeZimbabwe [Chapter 12:07] njalo, ngoba amaklayenti ethu amanengi ahlala emzini, i-UK GDPR.
privacyPage.s1Text: Imininingwane yokuthintana (ibizo, i-email, inombolo yeWhatsApp, ilizwe), imininingwane ngesitandi loba ukwakha kwakho okhetha ukuyabelana, amaphepha owafakayo (njengama-title deeds lezivumelwano zokuthengisa), imibhalo yokubhadala, lemilayezo osithumela yona.
privacyPage.s2Text: Ukwenza imisebenzi oyicelayo: ukubhuka izingcingo, ukulungisa amakhotheshini, ukuhlola isitandi, ukuthenga impahla, ukubika kuwe, lokubhadalisa. Kasithengisi i-data yakho njalo kasiyisebenzisi ekukhangisweni kwabanye.
privacyPage.s3Text: I-data yakho igcinwa labagcini be-cloud abathembekileyo. Amaphepha agcinwa endaweni eyimfihlo, efinyelelwa kuphela ngama-link alesikhathi esibekiweyo nguwe labasebenzi beLBH abavunyelweyo.
privacyPage.s4Text: Nguwe kuphela labasebenzi beLBH abayidingayo emsebenzini wakho. Abasebenzi basensimini babona kuphela imininingwane yomsebenzi abayidingayo — hatshi intengo, amakhotheshini loba izimbadalo zakho.
privacyPage.s5Text: Ungacela ikhophi ye-data yakho, ukulungiswa kwe-data engaqondanga, loba ukucitshwa kwe-akhawunti le-data yakho. Izixhobo zokukhipha lokucitsha zikhona kuzilungiselelo zeportal yakho, loba usithinte sizakwenzela.
privacyPage.s6Text: Sigcina imibhalo yemisebenzi ephelileyo (kugoqela imibiko lemibhalo yokubhadala) okwesikhathi esifunwa ngumthetho wemithelo le-audit, besesiyicitsha.
privacyPage.s7Text: Ngombuzo munye ngamunye wobumfihlo, sithinte nge-email loba iWhatsApp ekhasini lokuSithinta.
